summary: Feed s064_single is degraded due to excessive encryption: 86.6% of bytes are encrypted vs IDS tolerance of 60%. IDS requires full payload inspection but cannot inspect encrypted payloads. All other checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, VLAN) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 86.6% of traffic is TLS/encrypted and is being forwarded without decryption; packet broker has no SSL visibility capability inline, so IDS receives opaque payloads it cannot analyze.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature and anomaly detection but 86.6% exceeds its 60% encrypted tolerance - encrypted attacks and C2 will be missed, severely reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: IDS cannot detect threats inside encrypted payloads; decrypt relevant TLS at packet broker (or forward to dedicated decryption zone) and re-encrypt after inspection, or selectively bypass trusted encrypted flows to bring encrypted share below 60%.
